name: Gandy Creek dispersed camping
winter_2026_27: No dates published. The area stays open until it is snow-covered and reopens when snow-free (FS 2026: 'Area opens when snow-free'); toilets reopen 2027-04-15 if the 2026 pattern repeats.
winter_loops: Whole Gandy Creek dispersed area (designated sites only), weather permitting; no per-site winter split published.
winter_limits: Closed while snow-covered; unplowed county road (CR 29); no water; vault toilet destroyed Aug 2026, replacement status unknown; free, designated sites only, 2 vehicles per site, 14-day limit.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open until the area is snow-covered and again once snow-free; the Forest Service gives no fixed dates. The vault toilet was destroyed in August 2026 and no replacement had been announced as of 2026-11-07.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation ('2026 Recreation Opening Dates ... Please note, dates are subject to change based on local weather conditions.' + 'Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping (County Route 29) — Area opens when snow-free; toilets open 4/15'); https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area-vault-toilet-temporarily-closed ('The vault toilet unit at the Gandy Creek Dispersed Area is closed due to structural damage ... requires a full replacement.' Alert Start Date: August 11, 2026, End Date: October 30, 2026); https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/newsroom/releases/2026-opening-dates-monongahela-national-forest-recreation-sites (2026-03-09: 'Roadside camping, also called dispersed camping or boondocking, is available in many areas of the Forest year-round.'); Lead only (newspaper reprint of the FS fall-2021 closing list, 2021-10-15): https://www.alleghenymountainradio.org/?p=21498 ('Johnny Meadows in Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area – Area closes when snow-covered; toilet closes Dec. 1'). All read 2026-11-07.
weak_spots: No fixed winter dates: the FS rule is weather-gated ('opens when snow-free'), and the explicit 'closes when snow-covered' wording is from the 2021 list, a lead only. Gandy is not on the FS fall-2025 closing list. The access road is County Route 29 (a county road, so no FS road order or MVUM season applies). The alert for the destroyed vault toilet ended 2026-10-30, but no notice says the replacement is built, so whether there is any toilet this winter is unknown. No 2026 closing-date list is posted yet: the FS recreation page carries only the 2026 opening dates, and neither the alerts page nor the 2026 press releases (pages 1-7) has a fall-2026 closing list.

name: Canaan Loop Road dispersed campsite #12
winter_2026_27: No closure published. The MVUM shows FR 13 (Canaan Mtn) open to passenger cars and motorhomes 01/01-12/31, and there is no current FS road order on FR 13.
winter_loops: Single roadside site on FR 13; no loops.
winter_limits: FR 13 is not groomed or plowed. The FS page calls the road a good cross-country ski venue, so expect it snow-covered. No water or facilities; the northern part of the loop crosses private land (permission from Allegheny Wood Products).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: Canaan Loop Road (FR 13) is open to vehicles all year on the Forest Service travel map, but it is not plowed and doubles as a cross-country ski route, so expect snow.

weak_spots: No FS page, opening/closing list entry or alert names Gladwin. The site is not on any MNF seasonal list (neither 2021, 2025 nor 2026), which fits year-round dispersed use but is silence, not a statement. Aggregator reviews (leads only) report mixed private/public ownership at the site.

name: Camp Run Campground
winter_2026_27: Open year-round (no winter closure); no alert for Camp Run or the North River district as of 2026-11-07.
winter_loops: All 9 sites; no seasonal loop closures published.
winter_limits: No water; vault toilet; no fee; first-come. Reached by VA 826 / WV CO 31 and FS 526 (FS 526 MVUM open 01/01-12/31, high-clearance maint. level 2). Popular with hunters in season.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open all winter like the rest of the year, with no water; the access road is not paved.
sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camp-run-campground ('Site Open'; 'Seasons of Use: Open year-round'; 'Open Season: Year Round, Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'); https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts (no Camp Run / North River order); USFS MVUM feature service https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_MVUM_01/MapServer/1 (FS 526 CAMP RUN RECREATION AREA: 'yearlong', motorhome '01/01-12/31'). Read 2026-11-07.
weak_spots: Winter plowing of CO 31 / FS 526 is not stated. Nearby FR 152 (Mitchell Knob) is a seasonal road (open 10/01-01/15) but is not the campground access.

name: Shavers Fork Dispersed Site (FR 47)
winter_2026_27: No closure published. The forest road to the site is designated open all year (MVUM 01/01-12/31), and the Forest Service says dispersed camping is available year-round in many areas.
winter_limits: Forest roads not plowed (no plowing published); no water, toilets or trash service; free, 14 days in 28.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: the forest road is open all year on the Forest Service travel map and no closure is posted, but the road is not plowed, so snow may block access.
sources: USFS MVUM feature service https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_MVUM_01/MapServer/1 (FR 47 WHITMEADOW mp 0-2.272: seasonal 'yearlong', motorhome '01/01-12/31'); https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/newsroom/releases/2026-opening-dates-monongahela-national-forest-recreation-sites (2026-03-09: 'Roadside camping, also called dispersed camping or boondocking, is available in many areas of the Forest year-round.'); https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts (no order on FR 47). Read 2026-11-07.
weak_spots: No FS page names this site. The verdict rests on the MVUM's year-round designation, the absence of a road order, and the forest-wide 'year-round in many areas' statement. Plowing and snow passability are unknown.
